scores.reasons: Gap: no website at all despite the best review base in the batch. Ability to pay: residential cleaning tickets are small, though 170 reviews imply steady repeat volume. Ease: a one-page site with booking is a day or two. Evidence: two independent marketplace snapshots agree on rating and phone, but Angi itself blocked access.

caveats: Google Search and Google Maps were blocked from this network (an 'unusual traffic' interstitial appeared), so no Google Business Profile could be opened directly; ratings and review counts come from third-party snapshots of Google data and are dated.

Angi and HomeAdvisor returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks to both fetch and the browser, so their rating figures are taken from search-result summaries of those listing pages rather than read on the page.

Phone numbers and addresses in batch.json could not always be verified: Jazz Construction Group's site publishes (908) 888-9418 rather than the batch number, and VLS Builders publishes two different numbers on its own site.

Town assignment is loose for the cleaning businesses: 'Cleaning and Organizing by Silvana' is listed by Angi in Morganville and 'Destiny Cleaning Services' has an individual Angi page under East Millstone, both while serving North Brunswick.
